winks.rationale: The surname Anderson is a well-known US place name (Anderson, SC and Anderson County in several states).
Carnegie is a real borough in Pennsylvania (also Carnegie, OK), an exact match to the name.
Medusa is a hamlet in Albany County, New York, an exact spelling match to the word.
Chapman is a real US town name (Chapman, KS and Chapman, NE) matching the word exactly.
Oakland is the exact name of the major California city and many other US towns.
Lenox is the exact name of towns in Iowa and Georgia (and the MA town itself).
Hershey is the exact name of a village in Nebraska as well as the PA town.
The surname Norcross is an exact match to Norcross, Georgia, a well-known US city.
The surname Carter is the exact name of counties in MT, OK, KY, TN and MO.
The surname Dutton matches small US towns Dutton, MT and Dutton, AL.
Elliot sounds like and nearly spells Elliott County, Kentucky.
Purgatory is the name of a Colorado resort/area and the Purgatoire River, matching the word.
Albany is the exact name of the New York state capital and towns in GA and OR.
Washington is the exact name of a US state, the capital, and dozens of towns/counties.
